managedRules.title: Organization rename rules
managedRules.description: Rules set by the organization. Checked before any user-defined rules; the first matching enabled rule wins.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Hostname to match, e.g. example.com. Subdomains also match.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the rule is active. Defaults to true.

label.title: Label
label.description: Optional description shown in the options page.

allowUserRules.title: Allow user-defined rules
allowUserRules.description: When false, user-defined rules are ignored and hidden in the options page. Defaults to true.
